name: extract-domain-not-prepared
description: zenrows#extract on a domain Extract does not serve: 403 REQS007 with reason domain_not_prepared, and not charged. Captured from api.zenrows.com.

body.detail: Extract has not been prepared for example.com yet. Prepare it with POST /v1/extract/prepared-domains (it takes a few minutes and costs no credits). Send 1 to 5 example URLs: one works, and we recommend 3 or more of the same page type. Then retry once GET /v1/extract/prepared-domains/example.com reports ready. Until then, use css_extractor. GET /v1/extract/domains lists what Extract serves today.
body.title: Extract is not prepared for the requested domain (example.com) (REQS007)
